text: I hope this can help someone dropping their temps. I have a small case, Thermaltake versa h 18, with 3 intake fans 120mm, 1 exhaust 120mm and 1 exhaust 140mm on top. The card under heavy load reached 81 °C constantly with 100% fan speed (very noisy and loud). I solved both the heating and the noise problems with a ghetto solution. First of all I removed the shroud, the fans and the backplate (which inside had a plastic wrapping). Especially the backplate was creating a hot air pocket between it and the pcb. Then I proceeded installing 3 static pressure 80mm 3000 rpm fans on top of the heat sink (with zip ties). Now the card under load reaches 76 °C max and is much more silent than with the stock fans.

In conclusion- if u want a better card than a 1060, but can’t afford a 1070- buy this one.
